summary: Completed frontend testing of B6.4 gated section in FAIRA Assessment Form. All B6.4 subsections (B6.4a-g) render correctly when 'Yes' is selected, hide when 'No' is selected, and all form fields are functional. B6.3 gated section also verified working correctly.
passed_tests: B6.4 conditional subsections appear only when 'Yes' is selected
B6.4 conditional subsections hide when 'No' is selected
B6.4a multiselect checkboxes (audience) work correctly - options: direct users/operators, affected individuals, internal decision-makers/managers, regulators/oversight bodies, not specified/unclear

B6.4b multiselect checkboxes (explanation methods) work correctly - options: on-screen explanation, reason codes, case notes, help article, support channel, formal written explanation, technical documentation only, Other (specify)
B6.4b 'Other (specify)' checkbox reveals conditional input field when checked
B6.4c dropdown (timing) works correctly - options: before interaction/use, at the point outputs are presented/used, after the outcome/decision, only during formal review/appeal, unknown/not specified

B6.4d multiselect checkboxes (explanation content) work correctly - options: purpose of ai system, what inputs influenced outcome, key factors/attributes, confidence/uncertainty indicators, human oversight involvement, how to request further explanation, how to challenge/seek review, not specified/unclear
B6.4e dropdown (accessibility) works correctly - options: plain language, somewhat technical, highly technical, unknown/not specified
B6.4f dropdown (limitations disclosed) works correctly - options: yes clearly communicated, partially mentioned, no, unknown/not specified
B6.4g optional notes textarea works correctly
Progress bar correctly updates when B6.4 fields are filled (29% -> 32%)
B6 section progress indicator shows 25% complete
Auto-save works with B6.4 subsections (timestamp visible)
B6.3 gated section also works correctly with subsections B6.3a-e
context_for_next_testing_agent: B6.4 gated section has been fully tested and is working correctly. The section has 7 subsections (B6.4a-g) that appear when 'Yes' is selected and hide when 'No' is selected. B6.3 also has a similar gated structure with 5 subsections (B6.3a-e). Both sections are functioning as expected. Progress bar correctly accounts for conditional fields.
